summary: Realty Income Corp filed an 8-K on July 10, 2026, to report entry into a Fifth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement, which amended and restated the prior credit facility. The filing updates the company's revolving credit capacity with a syndicate of lenders. Wells Fargo Bank, National Association serves as Administrative Agent. No specific terms (price, premium, stake) or special-situation elements are present. This is an ordinary refinancing of a credit facility, not a special situation. No event-driven or risk-arb angle applies.
